title: Natural Language Processing with Python
subtitle: Analyzing Text with the Natural Language Toolkit
author: Steven Bird, Ewan Klein, Edward Loper
description: A practical introduction to natural language processing using Python and NLTK: text processing, tagging, classification, parsing grammars, and information extraction, with runnable examples throughout.
